name: Greek Yogurt Bowl
steps: Toast oats and roughly chopped almonds in a dry pan over medium-low heat for 4 minutes, stirring until fragrant. Spread on a plate to cool.
Wash and dry berries. Remove strawberry tops and slice; cut the peeled banana into rounds.
Stir yogurt until smooth and divide equally among 4 bowls. Arrange strawberries, blueberries and banana in separate sections.
Scatter cooled oats and almonds over each bowl, drizzle with honey and serve immediately.
tips: Use unsweetened Greek yogurt and add the toasted topping just before serving to retain crunch.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
